integrity: Embedded content hashes and byte counts are computed over exact UTF-8 bytes. Standalone verifier has no third-party dependencies.
scientific_limitations: Only quandle homomorphisms between the transposition conjugacy-class quandles of symmetric groups are classified. The n>=5 injective-or-constant property was already known from primitivity; the newly assessed claim is the target-specific embedding classification, cross-size counts and n=4 quotient semigroup. Finite verification is not an infinite proof. Global publication priority and independent scientific audit remain unestablished.
title: Cross-size homomorphism rigidity for transposition quandles with a unique four-vertex quotient
